answer: Marble-Pair Physical Witness: each agent identity registers one uniquely patterned marble held in a sealed, tamper-evident offline capsule, plus a juniper-oil marker whose batch number is logged. A rotating witness cohort must physically inspect the capsule at unpredictable intervals, matching pattern and batch; missed inspections void the identity. A fable token is irrelevant here. Each fake identity costs a distinct physical artifact, secure shipping, and human inspection labor, so mass registration is bounded by handling capacity, not computation.
